name: Distributed Ortholidar Processing via Spark
definition: A distributed computing pipeline that scales the ortholidar rendering to arbitrary large datasets using the Apache Spark framework, leveraging Resilient Distributed Datasets (RDD) and Dataframe abstractions.
summary: Distributed Ortholidar Processing via Spark renders massive lidar point clouds into 2D orthographic images using Apache Spark, aggregating dimensionality attributes into sparse tiles to prevent network bottlenecks.
